lines.text: An ant crawls this prism, one random edge every second.
lines.caption: An ant crawls this prism, one random edge every second.

lines.text: Which corner does it hit first, E or A?
lines.caption: Which corner does it hit first, E or A?

lines.text: The ant starts at C. All three edges there are equally likely.
lines.caption: The ant starts at C. All three edges there are equally likely.

lines.text: What's the chance it reaches E before A?
lines.caption: What's the chance it reaches E before A?

lines.text: Look at the front face, A B E D. A and E are opposite corners.
lines.caption: Look at the front face, A B E D. A and E are opposite corners.

lines.text: Spin the prism a half turn.
lines.caption: Spin the prism a half turn.

lines.text: A and E swap, and so do C and F. Same prism!
lines.caption: A and E swap, and so do C and F. Same prism!

lines.text: So F's chance is one minus C's chance.
lines.caption: So F's chance is one minus C's chance.

lines.text: Use that in the corner rules, and eleven c equals four.
lines.caption: Use that in the corner rules, and eleven c equals four.

lines.text: So the chance from C is four over eleven!
lines.caption: So the chance from C is four over eleven!
